# KEY: # KEY is b:XXXX for PRG bank b (0-7, 7 = fixed bank at $C000) or ram:XXXX for RAM/WRAM.

NAME: FAR_CALL
[comment]: Call routine in another bank (inline: bank, address-1)

NAME: BANK_SAVE_SWITCH
[comment]: Remember current bank in $1A, then switch to bank X

NAME: BANK_SWITCH_NMI
[comment]: Map PRG bank X at $8000 (resets MMC1 if interrupted)

NAME: BANK_RESTORE
[comment]: Map the bank saved by BANK_SAVE_SWITCH
